shots.title: 52 Card Pickup
shots.instructions: Prepare the shot, start your screen recorder, then press Space. Record the full 52-card fall and keep rolling for 10-15 seconds as the cards settle. Get a wide take, then an optional closer or slow-motion take. Same seed repeats the starting layout.

shots.title: Ghost Hands
shots.instructions: Use Prototype 014 and its Ghost Hands preset for this historical shot. Show both hands, then press Enter to release the cards.

shots.title: Solid Movement Icons
shots.instructions: Use Prototype 011 for this historical four-icon shot. Keep the HUD visible, draw a card, and show each mode icon and its active highlight. Shift gives fine control.

shots.title: Admin Recording Tools
shots.instructions: Optional dev-log shot: open Esc, show 52 Card Pickup in the shot list, prepare it, then close the menu and press Space. Show how a feature can be replayed for recording. Capture this menu only when explaining the tools.

shots.title: Mouse Movement in 3D
shots.instructions: Draw a card and keep Move selected. Hold the left button and drag sideways and up or down. Scroll in both directions while still holding the card, then keep dragging at the new depth. Repeat with Shift for a precise adjustment.

shots.title: Hold E to Rotate
shots.instructions: Use Prototype 011 for the original E shortcut. Keep the HUD visible. Draw a card in Move mode. While holding left click, hold E and move the mouse to rotate. Release E while keeping left click held, then move the card again.

shots.title: Hold T to Tilt
shots.instructions: Keep the three-button HUD visible. Draw a card in Move. Hold left click and T, then move the mouse sideways to tilt. Release T and move or scroll without releasing the card.

shots.title: Rotate with R and Click to Reset
shots.instructions: With the HUD visible, grab a card and hold R to rotate. Hold T and move sideways to tilt. Release the drag and click Reset cards to show the table clearing and the deck refilling.

shots.title: Click to Commit a Pair
shots.instructions: Use Prototype 014 for this historical shot. Position two cards, lock each with L, then click Commit pair.

shots.title: Automatic Two-Card Steps
shots.instructions: Use Prototype 015. Draw and position the first card, then let go. Show it waiting in place. Draw and position the second, then let go to release both. Place a second pair while the earlier cards remain on the table.

shots.title: Commit Each Card, Then Release the Pair
shots.instructions: Keep the HUD visible. Place the first card and click Commit card. Repeat with the second and briefly show both cards held in place. Click Commit pair to release them, then draw the next card.

shots.title: Challenges and Ghost Layouts
shots.instructions: Use Shift+Esc to prepare the Bridge preview. Toggle its guide, place two triangles, then use Release card for the top. Separately use a normal level to show its cards and completion retained after returning from the main menu.

shots.title: Building a Third Floor
shots.instructions: Prepare the three-floor pyramid. Record the ghost guide, building upwards, and the last pair settling on the top floor.
